weekly_theme.summary: 太陽剛進入射手座不久，生活重心可能悄悄轉往射手座相關的主題與氣氛。

aries.horoscope: 白羊座，今天是您大獲全勝的日子！持續向前邁進，直到達成您的目標。記住，不要讓他人的懷疑拖累您。相信自己的能力，相信您與周圍人互動的方式。就算有人心情低落，也不代表您需要跟著一起沮喪，才能讓對方振作起來。相反地，您能給予的最有力的回應是散發您自己的喜悅。
aries.horoscope_en: Today is your day to score big, Aries! Keep pushing forward until you achieve your goals. Remember, don’t let the doubts of others weigh you down. Trust in your own abilities and how you interact with those around you. Just because someone is feeling down doesn’t mean you need to share in their gloom to lift their spirits. Instead, the most powerful response you can offer is to radiate your own joy.

taurus.horoscope: 金牛座，星象顯示您終於可以說出心中所想。是時候將這些想法公諸於世了。有所保留只會讓您感到沉重。放下對後果的恐懼，勇敢邁出那一步。今天需要勇氣和果斷。請記住，如果您準備好說出自己的真心話，也要敞開心胸，接受別人對您的真心話。
taurus.horoscope_en: Taurus, the stars align for you to finally express what’s been on your mind. It’s time to bring those thoughts into the light. Holding back will only weigh you down. Let go of your fears about the aftermath and take that leap. Today calls for courage and assertiveness. Just remember, if you’re ready to share your truth, be open to receiving the same in return.

gemini.horoscope_en: Today, Gemini, your viewpoints are likely to steal the spotlight in discussions. With your strong convictions, you're ready to share your thoughts boldly. Embrace this opportunity to share your vast knowledge and insights. Take the lead in conversations and relish the challenge of persuading others to see things your way. Regardless of the outcome, the experience will be enjoyable!

cancer.horoscope_en: Today, Cancer, your emotions might be ignited by a sense of anger. It's important to express how you truly feel, even if it risks upsetting others. Holding back could lead to misunderstandings, as those around you may not have the complete picture to make informed choices. By sharing your viewpoint, you can help clarify the situation for everyone involved.

leo.horoscope: 獅子座，今天您可能會發現一股充沛的體力在您身上湧動。如果朋友需要幫忙搬家具，您一個人就能輕鬆抬起那張沙發！不要低估自己的能力；您擁有深藏不露的內在力量。現在是時候擁抱並展現您內在的這股強大力量了。
leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, you may discover a surge of physical energy coursing through you. If a friend needs assistance with moving furniture, you could easily lift that couch all on your own! Don’t underestimate your capabilities; you possess a reservoir of inner strength that you often keep under wraps. It’s time to embrace and showcase this incredible power you have within.

virgo.horoscope: 處女座，是時候揚帆起航了，所以記得要登上那艘船！今天，其他人可能不會那麼理解您的情緒困擾，因此明智的做法是把這些感受藏在心裡。抱怨可能會導致被拋下。今天的氛圍鼓勵您培養韌性。請記住，這不是人身攻擊；我們都有寶貴的經驗教訓需要學習。一個關鍵的學習重點是知道什麼時候該閉嘴。
virgo.horoscope_en: It's time to set sail, Virgo, so make sure you jump on that ship! Today, others may not be as understanding of your emotional struggles, so it's wise to keep those feelings to yourself. Complaining could lead to being left behind. The vibe of the day is encouraging you to build resilience. Remember, it's not a personal attack; we all have valuable lessons to grasp. One key takeaway is recognizing when to hold your tongue.

libra.horoscope: 天秤座，今天是您展現領導力的一天！把握領導的機會，並將任務委派給您身邊的人。大膽果斷的態度對您有益，您具備取得出色成果的技能。雖然您可能會想親自處理所有事情，但與他人合作不僅能讓他們參與其中，還能讓您專注於較少的責任，並在真正重要的事情上脫穎而出。
libra.horoscope_en: Today is the day for you to take charge, Libra! Embrace the opportunity to lead and delegate tasks to those around you. A bold and assertive attitude will serve you well, and you possess the skills to achieve great results. While it might be tempting to tackle everything on your own, collaborating with others will not only engage them but also allow you to focus on fewer responsibilities and excel in what truly matters.

scorpio.horoscope: 天蠍座，今天明智的做法是保護好您的心，因為可能會有人對您說出刻薄的話。在這個艱難的環境中，您與生俱來的敏感可能會讓您感到孤立，因此不妨考慮在家休息一天。不過，如果您選擇外出，請善用您的情商。找出您的弱點，以便有效地引導您的能量。
scorpio.horoscope_en: Today, Scorpio, it's wise to protect your heart as harsh words may be directed your way. Your innate sensitivity might leave you feeling isolated in this tough environment, so consider taking a day to rest at home. However, if you choose to venture out, arm yourself with your emotional intelligence. Identify your vulnerabilities to channel your energy effectively.

sagittarius.horoscope_en: Sagittarius, the world could certainly benefit from more individuals like you in positions of influence. Don't doubt your potential! The cosmic energies today are empowering you with the confidence and vitality necessary to enhance your leadership skills. Seize this moment to take charge of your circumstances. You’ve got this!

capricorn.horoscope: 摩羯座，雖然人們常說言語不會傷害您，但今天您可能會發現，有些尖刻的言語和行為是針對您的。請保持警惕，因為有強烈的能量在作祟，可能會引發情緒緊張。如果您不謹慎行事，可能會引發衝突。專注於促進和諧與維持和平。
capricorn.horoscope_en: While it's often said that words can't harm you, Capricorn, today you might find that some harsh words and actions are aimed your way. Stay vigilant, as there are intense energies at play that could stir up emotional tensions. If you're not cautious, conflicts could arise. Focus on fostering harmony and keeping the peace.

aquarius.horoscope_en: Today, you may find emotions running high as those around you exhibit a rather self-serving demeanor, Aquarius. Remember, selfishness isn't inherently bad; at times, it's essential to prioritize your own needs. Focus on self-care and avoid engaging in conflicts when others are acting in their own interest.

pisces.horoscope: 雙魚座，今天您可能會感覺到一股充滿活力的能量圍繞在您身邊。做好準備，迎接挑戰。雖然許多人看到外面的混亂可能會猶豫不決並退縮，但您卻迫不及待地想一頭栽進去。強烈的情緒將成為您今天的工具，眾所周知，您在這個領域擁有出色的能力。
pisces.horoscope_en: Today, Pisces, you may feel a surge of vibrant energy surrounding you. Gear up and prepare to face challenges head-on. Intense emotions will be your tools for the day, and it's well-known that you possess a remarkable strength in this area.
